name: Ren'ai Multiple!
source: One day, four girls confessed their love to Kazuya at the same time. They don't mind being his girlfriend, all four of them at the same time, either. Surrounded by girls, Kazuya's polygamous life begins.
translation: 一天，四名女孩同时向和也告白。她们甚至不介意四个人同时成为他的女朋友。被女孩们环绕的和也，就此开始了多角恋生活。
